content:
incident-bot: SEV2 - cross-region steering anomaly detected between ap-southeast1 <-> eu-west1. Sudden steering flips observed starting 2026-03-12T14:01:13Z. Elevated 5xx and p99 for api/generate. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

rachel: noticed customer reports about 14:01 UTC — p95 jumped from 220ms -> 1.1s for APAC users, 5xx up ~2.8 percentage points.

dennis: I'm on netops. Control plane shows a rollout job touching "latency-steer-v3" at 14:00:58Z. There was a concurrent operator reconciliation loop thrashing weights.

yuki: runtime: we see applied_weights oscillating; some requests in ap-southeast1 are being served out of eu-west1 causing RTT spike + KV cache cold starts.

amir: support: two enterprise customers filed alerts. CS is triaging SLA impact.

ops-bot: action required: invoke runbook 'cross-region-steering' -> https://redwood.runbooks/cross-region-steering (step 1 to 6).

tanya: declaring incident SEV2. Suggest immediate stabilization: pause operator, apply per-customer pins for strict-pinned customers, and rollback the rollout job if recent commit suspect.

rachel: agree. Also capture control-plane snapshot and dump policy-agent logs.

dennis: grabbing policy-agent dump now:
```
# policy snapshot 14:02:05Z
target_policy: latency-steer-v3
desired_weights: ap-southeast1:0.62 eu-west1:0.38
applied_weights: ap-southeast1:0.15 eu-west1:0.85
operator_state: reconciling
last_commit: commit-5f9c (2026-03-12T14:00:55Z)
```
Mismatch confirmed.

yuki: runtime command to pin customers:
```
redwoodctl pin --customer=ent-3344 --region=ap-southeast1 --reason="mitigate-steer-flip" --ttl=30m
```
I can batch that for all impacted customers. Need confirmation.

amir: do it. Also prepare customer comms: notify impacted customers and offer priority support.

incident-bot: oncall-ack: rachel accepted at 2845678910.

dennis: paused operator: `policy-operator pause --id=latency-steer-v3` -> paused at 14:03:20Z.

incident-bot: action taken: operator paused by dennis at 2845679000.

yuki: applied pins to 4 strict-pinned customers. Telemetry shows immediate p99 improvement for those customers (~700ms down).

rachel: metrics: global 5xx decreased from +2.8% -> +0.9% (10 minutes after pinning). APAC p95 is back to ~350ms. Good.

tanya: should we rollback commit-5f9c? What risk of rollback causing new instability?

dennis: commit touches weight interpolation logic. I recommend rollback + small canary once stable. Rollback command:
```
policy-operator rollback --commit=commit-5f9b --target=latency-steer-v3
```
I'll run it if no objections.

amir: approve rollback. CS: prepare update saying mitigation in place and investigating root cause, ETA for RCA 24-48h.

jason: ops: when you rollback, watch for flapping; set a 2-minute guard window to prevent auto-reconcile. Also don't touch DNS TTL yet.

yuki: executing rollback now.

ops-bot: policy-operator: rollback initiated by dennis at 2845679062.

rachel: post-rollback checks: at 14:08 UTC applied_weights converge to desired_weights, no further flips. Keep pins for 30m to ensure KVs warm in correct region.

amir: customer comms sent to 4 impacted accounts and public status note updated to 'investigating -> mitigated'.

tanya: oncall handoff: I'll take lead for next 6 hours to drive RCA. @rachel handing off.

rachel: handoff notes: state=mitigated, actions taken=operator paused, rollback to commit-5f9b, 4 customer pins applied until 14:38 UTC, telemetry snapshots in runbook ticket RINC-7721.

incident-bot: incident state updated to 'mitigated' by rachel at 2845679150.

yuki: addendum: we found an edge-case in interpolation when operator receives near-simultaneous reconcile signals from two controllers. Patch proposed to add leader-election and a rate limit to weight changes.

dennis: scheduling hotfix deploy to staging and will run controlled rollout. RCA to include tests for multi-controller convergence.

amir: closing notes for now: impact window ~14:01-14:09 UTC, impacted APAC p95/p99 spikes, 4 customers pinned temporarily, no data loss. Postmortem owners: dennis (netops), yuki (runtime), rachel (incident lead), amir (customer comms).

ops-bot: reminder: create postmortem doc and link to runbook within 24h.

tanya: acknowledged. Will circulate invite and draft.

rachel: final watch: revert pins after 30m if stable. If we see any new >2% 5xx increase re-open incident. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
